title: BUGFIX — FailureLibraryAgent: dedup by video_id to prevent triple-filing
rationale: PublishingAgent (Blotato path) emits one PublishedVideo per successful platform — 9 platforms × 33 videos = 297 published entries. AnalyticsAgent creates one PerformanceSignal per PublishedVideo. When mock KPIs assign completion_rate < 40% to 3/9 platform signals for each video, FailureLibraryAgent files 3 entries per video (99 total instead of 33). Root cause: FailureLibraryAgent had no dedup by video_id. Fix: before processing failure signals, group by video_id and keep only the worst-performing signal (lowest completion_rate) per unique video. From 99 → 33 unique failure entries, one per video.

tasks.description: In FailureLibraryAgent.run(), add dedup pass before the processing loop: build worstByVideo Map<string, PerformanceSignal> keyed by video_id, keeping the signal with the lowest completion_rate. Process only the deduped signals. Updated log line shows unique video count vs total signal count. Confirmed: 297 signals → 99 failure flagged → 33 unique videos filed (was 99).
